context.situation: A colleague wants to start a study group with you before work. First you need to compare your daily routines.
context.situation_ar: زميل يريد أن تبدآ مجموعة دراسة قبل العمل. أولًا تحتاجان إلى مقارنة روتينكما اليومي.
context.goal: Describe your typical day and say how often you do things.
context.goal_ar: أن تصف يومك المعتاد وتقول كم مرة تفعل الأشياء.

script.t: So, what time do you usually get up?
On weekdays? Around half past six. I'm not a morning person, though.
Half six! That's early. Do you have breakfast at home?
Not really. I usually just have a coffee, and then I leave home at seven fifteen.
How do you get to work?
I catch the bus. It takes about forty minutes, so I often read on the way.
And when do you get home?
At about six. I sometimes go to the gym first, but I never go to bed late. I'm always tired by ten!
OK, so mornings before work are no good for you.
No, but my lunch break is free. What about twelve thirty?

notice.explain: Frequency words go before the main verb (I often read), but after be (I'm always tired).
notice.explain_ar: كلمات التكرار تأتي قبل الفعل الرئيسي، وبعد فعل be.

notice.explain: With am / is / are, the frequency word comes AFTER the verb.
notice.explain_ar: مع am/is/are تأتي كلمة التكرار بعد الفعل.

grammar.title: How often: always, usually, often, sometimes, never
grammar.context: I usually just have a coffee. I often read on the way. I'm always tired by ten.
grammar.pattern: subject + always / usually / often / sometimes / never + verb   ·   subject + be + always …
examples: I usually get up at seven.
We sometimes go to the gym.
grammar.explain: Put the frequency word before the main verb, but after am / is / are.
grammar.explain_ar: ضع كلمة التكرار قبل الفعل الرئيسي، وبعد am/is/are.
